::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: saddle-point-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f(x) = x1^2 - x2^2 for x1 and x2 from -1 to 1. The
#|   surface is shaped like a saddle: it curves upward along the x1 axis and
#|   downward along the x2 axis. A solid vermilion curve along the x1 axis
#|   rises away from the origin, a dashed vermilion curve along the x2 axis
#|   falls away from it, and a point marks the saddle point at the origin.
sp_x_sf <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 61)
sp_grid_sf <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = sp_x_sf, x2 = sp_x_sf)
sp_value_sf <- sp_grid_sf$x1^2 - sp_grid_sf$x2^2
sp_n_sf <- length(sp_x_sf)
sp_z_sf <- matrix(sp_value_sf, nrow = sp_n_sf)
sp_up_sf <- tibble::tibble(x1 = sp_x_sf, x2 = 0, z = sp_x_sf^2)
sp_down_sf <- tibble::tibble(x1 = 0, x2 = sp_x_sf, z = -sp_x_sf^2)
sp_origin_sf <- tibble::tibble(x1 = 0, x2 = 0, z = 0)
sp_solid_sf <- list(color = "#D55E00", width = 5)
sp_dash_sf <- list(color = "#D55E00", dash = "dash", width = 5)
sp_marker_sf <- list(color = "#000000", size = 5)
sp_stops_sf <- c(0, 1)
sp_cols_sf <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
sp_scale_sf <- list(sp_stops_sf, sp_cols_sf)
sp_eye_sf <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
sp_camera_sf <- list(eye = sp_eye_sf)
sp_xaxis_sf <- list(title = "x1")
sp_yaxis_sf <- list(title = "x2")
sp_zaxis_sf <- list(title = "f(x)")
sp_scene_sf <- list(
  xaxis = sp_xaxis_sf,
  yaxis = sp_yaxis_sf,
  zaxis = sp_zaxis_sf,
  camera = sp_camera_sf
)
sp_legend_sf <- list(orientation = "h")
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = sp_x_sf,
    y = sp_x_sf,
    z = sp_z_sf,
    colorscale = sp_scale_sf,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.8
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = sp_up_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = sp_solid_sf,
    name = "f(t, 0) = t^2"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = sp_down_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = sp_dash_sf,
    name = "f(0, t) = -t^2"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = sp_origin_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = sp_marker_sf,
    name = "saddle point"
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = sp_scene_sf, legend = sp_legend_sf)
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: saddle-point-3d-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f(x) = x1^2 - x2^2 for x1 and x2 from -1 to 1. The
#|   surface is shaped like a saddle: it curves upward along the x1 axis and
#|   downward along the x2 axis. A solid vermilion curve along the x1 axis
#|   rises away from the origin, a dashed vermilion curve along the x2 axis
#|   falls away from it, and a point marks the saddle point at the origin.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

sp_t_3d = np.linspace(-1, 1, 61)
sp_x1_3d, sp_x2_3d = np.meshgrid(sp_t_3d, sp_t_3d)
sp_z_3d = sp_x1_3d**2 - sp_x2_3d**2
sp_zero_3d = np.zeros_like(sp_t_3d)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(sp_x1_3d, sp_x2_3d, sp_z_3d, color="#0072B2", alpha=0.6)
ax.plot(sp_t_3d, sp_zero_3d, sp_t_3d**2, color="#D55E00",
        label="f(t, 0) = t^2")
ax.plot(sp_zero_3d, sp_t_3d, -sp_t_3d**2, "--", color="#D55E00",
        label="f(0, t) = -t^2")
ax.scatter([0], [0], [0], color="black", label="saddle point")
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](functions.qmd#def-graph) of $f(\vx) = x_1^2 - x_2^2$.
Along the $x_1$ axis (solid curve) the surface rises away from the origin,
and along the $x_2$ axis (dashed curve) it falls away,
so the origin is neither the lowest nor the highest point nearby.

:::
